topics.purpose: Define each emitted Event occurrence as explicit immutable evidence with exact type, producer, subject, payload, source execution and time.

semantics.identity_rule: Each Event occurrence has explicit identity.
semantics.type_rule: Exact Event type identity is referenced.
semantics.subject_rule: Affected subject/resource identity is explicit where applicable.
semantics.payload_rule: Payload validates against exact Event type.
semantics.causality_rule: Causal refs are explicit and not inferred from timestamp.
semantics.immutability_rule: Emitted Event evidence is immutable; corrections create new related evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Event occurrence itself grants no downstream operation authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
